response: Intra-abdominal desmoid disease does not affect patients with an ileal pouch differently than those with an ileorectal anastomosis. The morbidity associated with desmoid tumors has been shown to be similar, regardless of whether they arise after restorative proctocolectomy (which involves creating an ileal pouch) or ileorectal anastomosis. This suggests that the type of surgical procedure does not have a significant impact on the outcome of patients with intra-abdominal desmoid disease.
